correctness.rationale: For n>=4, the difference of two triple incidence columns produces every even-pair vector, while a triple is odd; hence B has full row rank. The exact point Gram matrix BB^T is I, I+J, 0 or J by n modulo four and is idempotent. From the block adjacency form, ranks of F,F^2,F^3,F^4 are 2n,n+d,2d,2d, and F^5=F^3. These ranks force n-d zero-Jordan chains of size three, m-2n+d zero chains of size one, and a 2d-dimensional recurrent involution. Its fixed space has dimension d by Qu=u, hence d eigenvalue-one chains of size two. First-entry exponent and equal recurrent phase basin sizes follow from the Fitting decomposition. Standalone direct rank checks pass for every 4<=n<=16, exhaustive 256 and 32768 binary initial states at n=4,5, and direct sampled trajectories in each residue class. Finite verification is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete 3-uniform incidence family is a natural balanced-design/finite-network object, and its synchronous graph rule has a mathematically motivated exact phase question. Unlike ordinary edge subdivisions, the triple incidence block has full row rank and yields a four-residue transition among complete one-step recurrence, one length-three transient chain, complete extinction, and a tiny 2-dimensional recurrent space. The sharp third-update fractions 1-q^(-1), 1-q^(-n), and 1-q^(-(n-1)) give a strong uniform asymptotic contrast across residues. These precise structural invariants determine complete orbit and basin censuses and are not an arbitrary finite slice or an unmotivated single-number computation.
